mapper.select: SELECT fact_id AS factId, owner_id AS ownerId, subject, subject_type AS subjectType, polarity, strength, scope_type AS scopeType, condition_json AS conditionJson, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, source_text AS sourceText, event_id AS eventId, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM diet_preference_fact WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY valid_from ASC, version_no ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM diet_memory_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, event_id AS eventId, owner_id AS ownerId, review_type AS reviewType, reviewer_type AS reviewerType, corrected_value AS correctedValue, note_text AS noteText, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM diet_memory_review WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_preference_fact SET valid_to = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND ( (scope_type = 'TURN' AND valid_from < #{turnBefore}) OR (scope_type = 'TEMPORARY' AND valid_from < #{tempBefore}) )
mapper.select: SELECT suspect_id AS suspectId, owner_id AS ownerId, subject, evidence_text AS evidenceText, pending_flag AS pendingFlag, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM diet_allergy_suspect WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND pending_flag = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
